scheme_name: PG Indira Gandhi Scholarship for Single Girl Child
authority: University Grants Commission (UGC), Ministry of Education, Govt of India
jurisdiction: Central UGC Scheme (Disbursed via National Scholarship Portal)
benefit: ₹36,200 per annum (₹3,100 per month) for the full 2-year duration of Master's degree

criteria.label: Girl student and single child of family
criteria.plain_description: Candidate must be an only girl child in the family (girl students who are twin daughters/fraternal daughters are also eligible).
criteria.source_clause: UGC Single Girl Child Guidelines Clause 2.1 - Eligibility Criteria
criteria.remediation: Upload ₹50 Stamp Paper Affidavit attested by SDM/First Class Magistrate certifying single girl child status.

criteria.label: Female candidate identity
criteria.remediation: Confirm female gender identity on profile.

criteria.label: Age at time of PG admission ceiling (<= 30 years)
criteria.plain_description: Candidate must be under 30 years of age at the time of admission to 1st year PG course.
criteria.remediation: Verify age on Class 10 marksheet or Aadhaar.

criteria.label: Aadhaar verified and bank account linked
criteria.plain_description: Candidate must have Aadhaar seeded with active bank account.
criteria.remediation: Upload Aadhaar card linked with bank account.

documents_to_carry: Affidavit on ₹50 Stamp Paper by SDM/Executive Magistrate stating Single Girl Child status
Proof of admission to regular 1st year Master's degree course (MA/MSc/MCom/MTech)
Undergraduate Degree certificate and consolidated marksheets
Aadhaar Card and Bank Account Passbook
process_steps: Register on NSP portal with OTR
Select Scheme: PG INDIRA GANDHI SCHOLARSHIP FOR SINGLE GIRL CHILD
Upload SDM-attested affidavit and PG fee receipt
Institute verification by College Nodal Officer
₹36,200 annual fellowship disbursed directly through PFMS/DBT
